headline: Anthropic is reportedly planning to open its share-sale roadshow on 9 November, with some investors valuing it at $1.8 trillion to $2 trillion.
score_reason: Lowered by 1: single report on unnamed sources, and its Thanksgiving target repeats an earlier Bloomberg report.
importance_line: What changed is that dates have been attached to the reported listing, which matters to investors and to the people who use or work with Anthropic's AI, then to rival AI companies, and the doubt is that it rests on unnamed sources and Anthropic has not confirmed it.
summary: Bloomberg reports, citing people familiar with the matter and as relayed by The Standard of Hong Kong, that Anthropic wants to list its shares as early as mid-November, before Thanksgiving, and to begin its roadshow (the sales tour to investors) on 9 November, after meeting potential investors at its San Francisco headquarters on 14 October. This continues the Bloomberg report of 1 Oct 2026 on a pre-Thanksgiving listing that our 4 Oct 2026 edition mentioned; the new details are the dates and the view of some investors that a fair value is between $1.8 trillion and $2 trillion.
notes: Original Bloomberg article not available here; read The Standard (Hong Kong), which names Bloomberg and its unnamed sources. Pool source NewsBytes was blocked. Unclear if this is the same Bloomberg report as 1 Oct or a later one.
